Багато англійських прикметників і дієслі: Many English adjectives and verbs have their own preposition: interested in, good at, afraid of, depend on, wait for. You can’t guess it from Ukrainian, so you need to learn these pairs. And after a preposition the verb always takes -ing.
Дієслово + прийменник: пара, яку треба з: Verb + preposition: a pair to remember
Our plans depend on the weather.
Після прийменника дієслово з -ing: After a preposition the verb takes -ing
Max is good at drawing comics.
look forward to + -ing: чекати з нетерпі: look forward to + -ing: to look forward to something eagerly
Я з нетерпінням чекаю зустрічі з двоюрід: I’m really looking forward to seeing my cousins.
У питанні прийменник іде в кінець: In a question the preposition goes at the end
be + прикметник + прийменник + іменник /: be + adjective + preposition + noun / pronoun / V-ing
дієслово + прийменник + додаток: listen: verb + preposition + object: listen to music, wait for a bus
заперечення не змінює прийменник: not +: the negative doesn’t change the preposition: not + adjective or verb + the same preposition
питальне слово на початку, прийменник у: question word at the start, preposition at the end of the question
після будь-якого прийменника дієслово ма: after any preposition the verb takes the -ing form, not to + V
Українська часто підказує інший прийменн: Ukrainian often suggests a different preposition: “depends from” is wrong, it’s depend on; “good in” is wrong, it’s good at; “proud with” is wrong, it’s proud of. Learn the pairs as a whole.
Деякі дієслова в англійській ідуть без п: Some English verbs take no preposition, even though Ukrainian has one: discuss something, enter a room, call / phone somebody, marry somebody, reach the top.
to у look forward to це прийменник: to in look forward to is a preposition
Після look forward to стоїть іменник або: After look forward to we use a noun or V-ing, not the base form of the verb.
Шпаргалка: найчастіші пари: Cheat sheet: the most common pairs
Ці сполучення краще вчити цілком, як одн: It’s best to learn these combinations as a whole, like one word. Columns: combination, example, translation.
добре / погано вміти щось: to be good / bad at doing something
пишатися кимось, чимось: to be proud of somebody or something
бути втомленим від чогось, набридло: to be tired of something, to be fed up with it
слухати когось, щось: to listen to somebody or something
чекати на когось, щось: to wait for somebody or something

depend on: залежати від. from здається л: depend on. from seems logical if you translate from Ukrainian, but it’s a mistake.
listen to: слухати щось або когось. at і: listen to: to listen to something or somebody. at and for don’t fit here.
wait for: чекати на когось або щось. to: wait for: to wait for somebody or something. We don’t use to or at with wait.
proud of: пишатися кимось. for і with ту: proud of: to be proud of somebody. for and with are wrong here.

tired of: набридло щось. on, at, for з t: tired of: to be fed up with something. We don’t use on, at or for with tired.
thank somebody for something: дякувати з: thank somebody for something: to say thanks for something.
keen on: захоплюватися чимось. in, at, o: keen on: to be keen on something. in, at and of are wrong here.
talk to somebody: говорити з кимось (мож: talk to somebody (talk with is also possible). at and on are wrong here.
scared of: боятися чогось, як і afraid o: scared of: to be scared of something, just like afraid of. We don’t use from here.
believe in: вірити в існування чогось. t: believe in: to believe that something exists. to, at and on are impossible here.
bad at: to be bad at something, just like good at.
look forward to: чекати з нетерпінням. f: look forward to: to wait eagerly for something. for seems logical, but people don’t say that.
Після прийменника at дієслово з -ing: dr: After the preposition at the verb takes -ing: drawing.
angry with somebody: сердитися на когось: angry with somebody: to be angry with somebody. on and to are word-for-word translations from Ukrainian.
Раунд 2. Заперечення і питання: прийменн: Round 2. Negatives and questions: the preposition at the end
interested in, і в питанні in іде в кіне: interested in, and in a question in goes at the end: What are you interested in?
wait for: in a question for comes at the end.
belong to: прийменник лишається в кінці: belong to: the preposition stays at the end of the question.
Заперечення не змінює прийменник: not go: The negative doesn’t change the preposition: not good at.
afraid of: in a question of goes at the end.
listen to: What do you listen to? Без to: listen to: What do you listen to? Without to the question is incomplete.
not interested in: прийменник той самий,: not interested in: the preposition is the same as in the positive.
depend on, навіть у питанні. from це кал: depend on, even in a question. from is a word-for-word translation from Ukrainian.
Питальне слово, допоміжне дієслово, підм: Question word, auxiliary verb, subject, preposition at the end: What are you looking at? Without at or without inversion it’s wrong.
apologise for something: вибачатися за щ: apologise for something: to say sorry for something. We use to before a person: apologise to me.
angry with somebody, і with іде в кінець: angry with somebody, and with goes at the end of the question. on and to are wrong.
agree with somebody: погоджуватися з ким: agree with somebody: to have the same opinion as somebody.
not keen on: to not really like something.
talk to somebody, тож у питанні to в кін: talk to somebody, so in the question to comes at the end.
proud of, і в запереченні теж: not proud: proud of, in the negative too: not proud of.
famous for: прийменник іде в кінець пита: famous for: the preposition goes at the end of the question.
concentrate on: зосереджуватися на чомус: concentrate on: to focus on something. in and at are wrong here.
Після does дієслово в базовій формі: bel: After does the verb is in the base form: belong. The preposition to comes at the end.
believe in: not believe in. on і to каль: believe in: not believe in. on and to are word-for-word translations.
good for: корисний для когось. good at о: good for: good for your health or for somebody. good at means “able to do something well”.
Тут про вміння: good at. good for це «ко: This is about a skill: good at. good for means “healthy, useful”.

arrive at: прибути до будівлі, станції,: arrive at: to arrive at a building, a station, an airport. arrive to is wrong.
arrive in: to arrive in a city or a country. at is for buildings and places, and we don’t use to with arrive.
laugh at: to laugh at somebody or something. on and to are wrong here.
spend money on something. for is a word-for-word translation from Ukrainian.
ask for something: просити щось. to, on,: ask for something: to ask to be given something. to, on and at are impossible here.
responsible for something. After for the verb takes -ing: feeding.
similar to: схожий на щось. with і as ту: similar to: like something. with and as are wrong here.
complain about something: скаржитися на: complain about something. We use to before the person we complain to.
pay for something: to give money for something.
full of: повний чогось. in, by, from тут: full of: containing a lot of something. in, by and from are impossible here.
be married to somebody: бути одруженим з: be married to somebody. with is a word-for-word translation.
suffer from: страждати від чогось. of і: suffer from something. of and on are wrong here.
congratulations on: вітаю з чимось. with: congratulations on something. with is a word-for-word translation from Ukrainian.
worry about something: to be anxious about it.
consist of: складатися з чогось. from це: consist of: to be made of parts. from is a word-for-word translation.
succeed in + V-ing: to manage to do something.
insist on: наполягати на чомусь. for і t: insist on something. for and to are wrong here.
Раунд 4. Пастки: зайві і чужі прийменник: Round 4. Traps: extra and wrong prepositions
discuss something без прийменника. discu: discuss something has no preposition. discuss about is a common mistake.
to у look forward to це прийменник, тому: to in look forward to is a preposition, so -ing follows: meeting.
Only depend on. from and of are word-for-word translations.
Find the sentence without a mistake.
call / phone / ring somebody без to, хоч: call / phone / ring somebody takes no to: call me, not call to me.

instead of + V-ing: rather than doing something.
reply to something. on is a word-for-word translation from Ukrainian.

responsible for: in charge of something.
